name: MIS Finance Audit Log All Establishments
description: FIN0076 v00.00.01  This report lists financial transactions for a chosen date range to allow interrogation of who performed those transactions and shows: date, time, user ID, NOMS Number, prisoner surname and initials, the transaction type, the account the transaction affected, the amount and whether a credit or debit. Created for a National Audit so covers the whole of the Estate.

dataset.name: Prisoner Transactions
dataset.query: dataset_base_ AS (SELECT DISTINCT AT_CASELOADS.ESTABLISHMENT_CODE_NK, AT_DIM_DATE_TRANSACTIONS.DAY_DATE, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.TXN_ENTRY_TIME, COALESCE(AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.MODIFY_USER_ID, COALESCE(AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.CREATE_USER_ID, 'Not Recorded')) AS TRANSACTION_CREATED_MODIFIED39, AT_DIM_TRANSACTION_TYPE.DESCRIPTION, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.TRANSACTION_ENTRY_AMOUNT, AT_DIM_TXN_POSTING_TYPE.TXN_POSTING_TYPE_DESCRIPTION, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.TXN_ID, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.TXN_ENTRY_SEQ, AT_DIM_ACCOUNT_CODE_TXN.ACCOUNT_NAME, AT_BUSINESS_DATE.DAY_DATE AS BUSINESS_DATE_, AT_TXN_OB.SURNAME, AT_TXN_OB.INITIALS, AT_TXN_OB.OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, BODIMIS.DIM_TRANSACTION_ENTRY_DESC.TRANSACTION_ENTRY_DESC, AT_DIM_TRANSACTION_TYPE.TRANSACTION_TYPE FROM BODIMIS.FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION, BODIMIS.DIM_ESTABLISHMENT AT_CASELOADS, BODIMIS.DIM_DATE AT_DIM_DATE_TRANSACTIONS, BODIMIS.DIM_TRANSACTION_TYPE AT_DIM_TRANSACTION_TYPE, BODIMIS.DIM_TXN_POSTING_TYPE AT_DIM_TXN_POSTING_TYPE, BODIMIS.DIM_ACCOUNT_CODE AT_DIM_ACCOUNT_CODE_TXN, BODIMIS.DIM_DATE AT_BUSINESS_DATE, BODIMIS.DIM_OFFENDER_BOOKING AT_TXN_OB, BODIMIS.DIM_TRANSACTION_ENTRY_DESC WHERE (AT_DIM_TRANSACTION_TYPE.TRANSACTION_TYPE_SK = AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.TRANSACTION_TYPE_SK) AND (AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.TRANSACTION_POSTING_TYPE_SK = AT_DIM_TXN_POSTING_TYPE.TRANSACTION_POSTING_TYPE_SK) AND (AT_DIM_DATE_TRANSACTIONS.DATE_SK = AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.TRANSACTION_ENTRY_DATE_SK) AND (AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.ACCOUNT_CODE_SK = AT_DIM_ACCOUNT_CODE_TXN.ACCOUNT_CODE_SK) AND (AT_CASELOADS.ESTABLISHMENT_SK = AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.ESTABLISHMENT_SK) AND (AT_BUSINESS_DATE.DATE_SK = AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.TRANSACTION_BUSINESS_DATE_SK) AND (AT_TXN_OB.ALIAS_OFFENDER_SK = AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.ALIAS_OFFENDER_SK AND AT_TXN_OB.BOOKING_SEQ = 1) AND (BODIMIS.DIM_TRANSACTION_ENTRY_DESC.TRANSACTION_ENTRY_DESC_SK = AT_FACT_OFFENDER_TRANSACTION.TRANSACTION_ENTRY_DESC_SK) AND ((AT_DIM_DATE_TRANSACTIONS.DAY_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE('01-03-2017 00:00:00', 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE('01-03-2017 00:00:00', 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AND AT_BUSINESS_DATE.DAY_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(TO_DATE('01-03-2017 00:00:00', 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'), 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') - 1 AND TO_DATE('01-03-2017 00:00:00', 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')) AND AT_DIM_TRANSACTION_TYPE.TRANSACTION_TYPE IN ('CHAR', 'CHARS', 'CASHD', 'RELA', 'RELS'))), dataset_ AS (SELECT ESTABLISHMENT_CODE_NK, DAY_DATE, TXN_ENTRY_TIME, TRANSACTION_CREATED_MODIFIED39, DESCRIPTION, TRANSACTION_ENTRY_AMOUNT, TXN_POSTING_TYPE_DESCRIPTION, TXN_ID, TXN_ENTRY_SEQ, ACCOUNT_NAME, BUSINESS_DATE_, SURNAME, INITIALS, OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, TRANSACTION_ENTRY_DESC, TRANSACTION_TYPE FROM dataset_base_)

dataset.name: MIS Load Date
dataset.query: dataset_base_ AS (SELECT BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG.BUSINESS_DATE FROM BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG WHERE (BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG.LOAD_ID = (SELECT MAX(LOAD_ID) FROM BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG WHERE NOT LOAD_END_DATETIME IS NULL))), dataset_ AS (SELECT BUSINESS_DATE FROM dataset_base_)
